technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Framework 6.0+ with Java 17 as the baseline for all development.
Kafka integration will leverage Spring Kafka to manage consumer offsets and partition assignments.
Partition pre-allocation logic will be implemented at the Spring XD container level to assign static partitions before stream deployment, avoiding rebalancing.
The reactor-stream processor module will be built using Project Reactor to handle time-window operations and aggregations.
Microbatching will be implemented as a configurable option on source modules to batch payloads based on time intervals.
Spark investigation will focus on Spark Streaming integration, resulting in a proof of concept and architectural recommendation.
assumptions: The developer is highly experienced with Spring XD, Kafka, and Spark.
Cloud resources (Rackspace) for performance testing are provisioned and accessible.
The TBD in U2 regarding undeploy/redeploy behavior is resolved by assuming that if no specific start offset is provided, the stream resumes from the last committed offset.
Existing CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks are in place and do not require significant setup.
Unit testing is included within each implementation activity.

activities.activity_description: Analyze user stories, resolve ambiguities, and design the overall architecture for Kafka offset control, partition pre-allocation, reactor-stream, and microbatching features.
Implement the ability to control the starting offset of the Kafka source when a stream is deployed, ensuring progress survives crashes and handling undeploy/redeploy logic (U2).
Implement pre-allocation of a set of partitions between Kafka source modules upon stream deployment to simplify deployment and prevent rebalancing (U3).
Extend partition pre-allocation to Spring XD's message bus to ensure no rebalancing occurs when a container crashes or is redeployed (U4).
Develop the reactor-stream processor module to ingest data from XD sources and process them using time-window operations with specified expressions (U6).
Implement microbatching capability to allow ingesting data based on batch intervals for enhanced performance throughput (U7).
Investigate Spark, develop a proof of concept, and identify the best appropriate design and implementation for XD integration (U5).
Set up performance testing infrastructure on Rackspace to benchmark Kafka baselines and XD use-cases (U8).
Write and publish wiki documentation for configuring new sources, sinks, processor modules, and new features (U1).
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all new features, ensuring they work together seamlessly within the Spring XD environment.
